WITH delivered_orders AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT pco.order_id, pco.pizza_id, pco.exclusions, pco.extras
    FROM pizza_customer_orders pco
    WHERE pco.order_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT order_id FROM pizza_clean_runner_orders WHERE cancellation IS NULL OR cancellation = '')
),
pizza_with_toppings AS (
    SELECT 
        d.order_id,
        d.pizza_id,
        d.exclusions,
        d.extras,
        pr.toppings
    FROM delivered_orders d
    JOIN pizza_recipes pr ON d.pizza_id = pr.pizza_id
)
SELECT * FROM pizza_with_toppings ORDER BY order_id, pizza_id
